Definition: hunger (as making to stoop with emptiness and pain)
BiblicalUsage: Kaphan is hunger that makes a man stoop — the emptiness that bends the body with pain. Eliphaz says at destruction and famine thou shalt laugh, and Job describes the solitary ones, fleeing into the wilderness, for want and famine, who were solitary.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that famine stoops a man, but it does not have the last word: the God who feeds ravens and clothes lilies is the same God who lifts the hungry.
